texts: CLASSREALM
Integrated Senior High School Attendance, Activity and Requirement Tracking,Teacher Lesson Planning, and Learning Materials Management System
“One Realm for Every Learning Journey.”
1. Introduction
System Overview and Client
CLASSREALM is an integrated educational management system for Senior High School.

It centralizes attendance (through rfid attendance), assessments (activities, quiz, summative test1, summative test2,  term examination), grades (auto grade cumputation), lesson planning(lesson plan guide generator), and learning materials (organizer of learning materials).
The system supports:Admin, Teacher (web, teacher web & app reponsive)Student, and Parent roles. (app)
Client: Ma’am Karen P. Gonzaga, Senior High School Mathematics Teacher.
The client handles Grade 11 General Mathematics for 3 sections.
2. Problem Statement
Current challenges experienced by the client
Academic records and teaching materials are stored across different files, applications, and platforms.
Attendance is manually recorded through index cards, making records harder to maintain and update.
Student scores and requirements require repeated manual recording and checking.
The client needs a centralized way to manage lessons, assessments, grades, attendance, and learning resources.
3. Objectives
What the project aims to achieve
Develop an integrated system that centralizes major classroom and academic management tasks.
Provide efficient attendance recording through manual input and ESP32-RFID integration.
Streamline activities, requirements, quizzes, examinations, grading, and performance monitoring.
Support teacher lesson planning and organized management of learning materials.
Provide students and parents with appropriate access to academic information.
Generate useful reports and analytics to support academic decision-making.
4. Major Features
Core capabilities of CLASSREALM
Classroom Management – manage academic setup, sections, subjects, schedules, and students.
Attendance Management – manual and ESP32-RFID attendance with offline-first synchronization.
Class Activities & Assessments – manage activities, requirements, quizzes, and examinations.
Exam Checker & Item Analysis – check objective responses and analyze exam performance.
Grades & Performance Analytics – calculate grades and monitor student/class performance.
Lesson Planning & Learning Materials – create lesson plans and organize authorized resources.
Student & Parent Access – provide appropriate access to academic information.
5. Benefits of the System
How CLASSREALM helps its users
Centralized Records – reduces scattered files and repeated manual recording.
Improved Efficiency – simplifies common teaching and classroom-management tasks.
Better Monitoring – makes attendance, grades, requirements, and performance easier to track.
Organized Teaching Resources – keeps lesson plans and learning materials accessible to the teacher.
Improved Communication – gives students and parents access to relevant academic information.
Reliable Attendance Workflow – supports local recording and later synchronization when connectivity is limited.
6. Project Overview
CLASSREALM — One Realm for Every Learning Journey
CLASSREALM brings essential Senior High School academic and classroom-management functions into one integrated platform.
The system is designed around the actual needs of the teacher, while providing appropriate student, parent, and administrator access.
Its goal is to reduce manual work, improve organization, and support better monitoring of student learning.
